title: Swahili greetings and basics
examples: Where can I learn to speak Swahili?

explain.say: Today we learn some simple Swahili words.
If you meet someone, you can say jambo to greet them.
To ask how someone is, you can say habari after your greeting.
When you want to say thank you, the word is asante.
Swahili is spoken in many countries in East Africa.
In real life, you can use these words when visiting a friend.

faq.q: What is the difference between jambo and habari?
faq.a: Jambo is a simple greeting meaning hello. Habari is more like asking about someone's news or well-being.
asks: What do I say when I see someone?
Is habari a greeting or a question?

faq.q: Can I use asante for everything?
faq.a: Asante means thank you, but you might need other words for other things. It is mainly for showing thanks.
asks: Is asante the only way to say thank you?

faq.q: In which countries is Swahili spoken?
faq.a: Swahili is spoken in several countries, most notably Kenya and Tanzania. You can find it in East Africa.
asks: Where is Swahili a common language?
Does Swahili only belong to one country?

faq.q: What is the best way to start a conversation?
faq.a: It is best to start with a simple greeting like jambo. Then you can follow up by asking habari.
asks: How do I start talking in Swahili?

faq.a: It is a tonal language, but learning basic greetings like jambo and asante is quite easy. Practice makes it much simpler.
asks: How quickly can I learn basics?

facts: It is widely spoken across East Africa.
Jambo is a common, simple greeting.
Asante means thank you in Swahili.

quiz.say: If you meet a friend and want to say hello, what should you say?
quiz.why: Jambo is the direct word for 'hello' in Swahili.

wrong.1: Habari means news or how are you, not a simple greeting.
wrong.2: Asante only means thank you, so it is not a greeting.
wrong.3: This is English, and we are learning the Swahili word.

quiz.say: You receive a gift and want to thank the giver. What word do you use?
quiz.why: Asante is the specific word used to express thanks in Swahili.

wrong.1: Jambo is used only when you first meet someone.
wrong.2: Habari asks about news, not for saying thank you.
wrong.3: This is an English word and not the Swahili thank you.

quiz.say: If you greet someone with jambo and then ask how they are, what word follows the greeting?
quiz.why: After the greeting jambo, you ask habari to inquire about their well-being.

wrong.0: This is an English word and not the Swahili question word.
wrong.2: Asante is for saying thank you, not for asking how someone is.
wrong.3: Saying jambo twice does not change the meaning of the question.
